title: ForwardingInfo
description: The ForwardingInfo data type describes the status and information related to forwarding of a task

orderId.description: The unique identifier of the signing order

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the task created by forwarding the original task

originalTaskId.description: The unique identifier of the original task that was forwarded

forwarderName.description: The name of the person forwarding this task

forwarderEmail.description: The email of the person forwarding this task

recipientName.description: The name of the person receiving this task

recipientEmail.description: The email of the person receiving this task

recipientMobile.description: The mobile number of the person receiving this task
